scope: Proposition 10.1 of the manuscript “Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas” (preprints/Ground-state-condensation-in-the-dilute-hard-sphere-gas-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3f861f3b57ec1d6a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants α0, D∗, c∗ > 0 such that, for D = N/K3 ≥ D∗ and r = α/D with α ∈ [α0/2, 2α0], every normalized complex bosonic ground vector satisfies B(Ψ) ≥ c∗/2 for all sufficiently large integer K. The volume threshold can be chosen uniformly when D ranges over a fixed compact subinterval of [D∗, ∞), and is independent of the chosen ground vector.
